450:t_014:1.en:
$$ラルク$$
「I won't lose...! I won't lose!!」

450:t_014:2.en:
$$ラルク$$
「I won't hand over the place $$ノノ$$'s coming home to, to the likes of you!!」

450:t_015:0.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Dodge, $$ラルク$$! An attack's coming!」

450:t_017:2.en:
$$チコ$$
「And weren't you supposed to be on the moon...!?」

450:t_017:3.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「I warped! Distance no longer matters to the bond between $$ノノ$$ and Big Sis!」

450:t_017:5.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「$$バスターマシン７号$$! Sixth-generation interstellar decisive weapon, assigned directly to the $$地球帝国宇宙軍$$'s $$太陽系直掩部隊$$!」

450:t_017:8.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「And...! $$ノノ$$ was such a fool!」

450:t_017:10.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「The truth is, I've known ever since $$シンジ$$ said it to me!」

450:t_017:11.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「It doesn't matter whether I have a $$バスターマシン$$ or not!」

450:t_017:13.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「Someone who thinks 'If only I had a $$バスターマシン$$' could never become a true Top! Because...!」

450:t_017:14.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「True power dwells in those who believe in their own strength to the very end!」

450:t_018:1.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「I'm sure a true $$バスターマシン$$ pilot...! The real $$ノノリリ$$...!」

450:t_018:2.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「Has a $$バスターマシン$$ in their heart!!」

450:t_020:0.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「All units, regroup! Reform around $$ノノ$$, and push the $$宇宙怪獣$$ back!!」

450:t_020:2.en:
$$甲児$$
「I can't let $$ノノ$$ outdo me!」

450:t_020:3.en:
$$タケル$$
「We'll believe in our own strength to the very end too!」

450:t_020:4.en:
$$葵$$
「And we'll fight to the end with that power!!」

450:t_020:5.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「Let's go, everyone! With hard work and guts!!」

450:t_021:2.en:
$$ヨーコ$$
「Do you mean that 'beginning of the end' $$ミカゲ$$ was talking about?」

450:t_021:4.en:
$$竜馬$$
「What's begun is the battle against $$バアル$$. It's sure as hell not the end of the universe.」

450:t_021:6.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「Yes...! $$ノノ$$ will fight with everything she's got too!」

450:t_021:7.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「As $$バスターマシン７号$$, as a $$トップレス$$, together with Big Sis!」

450:t_021:9.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「Big Sis... I should have said this sooner, but $$ノノ$$... is home now.」

450:t_022:0.en:
$$カレン$$
「We swept them all up at once!」

450:t_022:1.en:
$$スザク$$
「Don't let your guard down! The enemy is overwhelming us with numbers!」

450:t_022:2.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Then we simply destroy them all at once! Let's do this!」

450:t_023:0.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Nice work, $$ノノ$$! ...Or should I call you $$バスターマシン７号$$?」

450:t_023:1.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「$$ノノ$$ is $$ノノ$$. Please call me whatever you like, $$ノリコ$$.」

450:t_023:2.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Got it! I'm counting on you from now on too, $$ノノ$$!」

450:t_023:4.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「What's wrong, Big Sis?」

450:t_023:6.en:
$$ラルク$$
(I could never say it... That for a moment, $$ノリコ$$ and $$ノノ$$ felt so far away...)

450:t_100:0.en:
$$カヲル$$
「What did you talk about with that girl $$ノノ$$?」

450:t_100:2.en:
$$カヲル$$
「I don't mean to pry. But it's been a while since you started a conversation with someone yourself, $$シンジ$$.」

450:t_100:4.en:
$$シンジ$$
「It's just... $$ノノ$$... reminded me a little of myself...」

450:t_100:7.en:
$$カヲル$$
「That's why I feel at ease with you. Come on, let's go.」

450:t_101:0.en:
$$ニコラ$$
(Every last one of them says whatever they please without a thought for how I feel...)

450:t_101:1.en:
$$ニコラ$$
(But I will avoid $$あがり$$, no matter what...! That's why I made connections with those sisters!)

450:t_102:0.en:
$$ラルク$$
(Wait for me, $$ノノ$$...! I'll make a place for you to come home to...!)

450:t_102:1.en:
$$ラルク$$
(So don't worry about anything! You don't have to become $$ノノリリ$$. Just stay with me!)

450:t_103:0.en:
$$ノリコ$$
(Why do these $$太陽系限定種$$ feel so wrong to me...?)

450:t_103:1.en:
$$ノリコ$$
(Is there more to them than being $$宇宙怪獣$$ from a parallel world...?)

450:t_104:0.en:
$$ノリコ$$
(The $$地球帝国宇宙軍$$... I haven't heard that name in a long time...)

450:t_104:1.en:
$$ノリコ$$
(Even if they're from a parallel world, with the $$地球帝国宇宙軍$$ and $$バスターマシン$$s together, we can't afford to lose...!)

450:t_104:2.en:
$$ノリコ$$
(Big Sis... $$ノリコ$$ will do her part too! I'll fight with $$ガンバスター$$ with all my strength to protect both Earths!)

450:t_105:0.en:
$$ラルク$$
(What are you, $$ノノ$$...? How can that tiny body have more fighting power than a $$バスターマシン$$...?)

450:t_105:1.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「Big Sis! Hard work and guts matter most when you're in a pinch!」

450:t_105:2.en:
$$ラルク$$
「I told you I hate that sort of thing!」

450:t_105:3.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「You're finally back to your usual self, Big Sis! Then let's go!」
